question: Do the 31 original SOXX 2011-2018 30-equity filings carry stable enough security identity to build a later point-in-time basket rotation field distinct from closed static concentration?
fixed_method: Read only the already NAS-backed original-filing result rows; never refetch SEC, market prices, labels or accounts.
Require each source report has 30 positive equity rows with original security name, original shares and original fair value; preserve filing acceptance and report-period identity.
Normalize Unicode and whitespace only for exact-name comparison; no alias, ticker or CUSIP inference and no weight renormalization.
For each adjacent report chronologically, report exact stable-name overlap, names only in prior/next, and whether within-report normalized names collide.
An unmatched name is identity-unknown, not confirmed exit/entry. No turnover factor until manually qualified original issuer/CUSIP bridge and full 2011-2026 disclosure timing.
stop: Stop if source hashes, report counts, row closures or within-report identity fail. If exact names are unstable, preserve gap and do not calculate turnover, tune names or fit on reused history.
